gate_review.sample_scope: For each case, 4097 points at 1024 cells and 8193 points at 2048 cells: endpoints, every knot and three quarter-cell locations. All use the unchanged 4096-panel direct evaluator; this is a finite sample comparison, not a continuum or absolute-accuracy certificate.
gate_review.endpoints_knots_and_domain: PASS: supplied a bits, direct t/b bits at all native knots including endpoints, finite positive H, sampled strictly increasing t, zero-shear fields and invalid/out-of-domain errors are checked in the observed matrix. Endpoint derivatives use the endpoint cell polynomial.
gate_review.algebraic_and_reflection: H_FLRW,H,s,sigma are bitwise equal to the direct reference at sampled points. Signed direct-reference reflection is checked at 8193 points for both +/- pairs. Candidate t/b interpolation uses the same signed-linear coefficients and identical grids, so even/odd parity is preserved structurally; separate candidate-reflection maxima were not emitted. No radiation/chemistry sign symmetry is admitted.

stable_interval.actual_endpoint_rule: Both references and stable increments use actual binary64 a endpoints and ln1p((a2-a1)/a1). Endpoint bits agree across the two levels.
stable_interval.qualification: Local 32/64-panel agreement is an empirical consistency check; stable Hermite increments are diagnostics and are not used by the production driver.

level_difference.interpretation: Observed level differences only; no order or uniform convergence claim.

subtraction.consequence: Driver::tentative currently subtracts cumulative point times at axbi_driver.rs:584. Both direct and interpolated subtraction can exceed the frozen local interval limit. Stable diagnostic PASS neither repairs that path nor removes the explicit production table HOLD.
subtraction.scope: An exact cache preserves the direct subtraction bits, including its existing cancellation. Cache parity cannot be described as a clock-accuracy repair. This finding alone does not invalidate retained baseline histories or establish their error; no trajectory effect was measured.

cache_review.mechanism: Exact a.to_bits keys, maximum 256 entries, deterministic FIFO, successful direct calls only, cached BackgroundPoint copied unchanged. Cache misses execute the pinned direct routine.
cache_review.evidence: Observed unit test covers endpoint/interior hit equality, eviction and exact error-tag agreement. All 36 paired timed direct/cache aggregate checksums match; repeated lists have 112 hits/16 misses and unique lists have 0 hits/128 misses.
cache_review.qualification: Timing checksums alone are not a seven-field per-query proof. Correctness also relies on the inspected cache implementation and immutable-instance use. The standalone cache exposes a public replaceable model, so this harness type must not be copied into production with stale entries surviving background replacement.
cache_review.separability: YES: a private cache bound to an immutable background can be reviewed as a bit-preserving optimization separately from table interpolation. Current evidence permits the next integration contract; it does not approve the unimplemented production change.

timings.scope: Observed same-host component queries with three repetitions; no whole-driver, whole-goal, parallel scaling or trajectory speedup measurement.
timings.construction_accounting: Shared 8193-point direct reference construction and each table assembly are separately measured. Reported amortization charges shared reference work plus selected assembly; it is not independently measured minimal standalone table construction.
timings.limitations: Each timed batch has only 128 queries and includes timer/proc-accounting overhead. Modes always run direct/cache/1024/2048 in that order; no randomized-order or host-isolation evidence is provided. These descriptive sample speedups have no statistical confidence claim.
timings.driver_hotpath: Source inspection shows repeated point_at_scale in ray, moments, geometry_map, inject and tentative. Reuse opportunity is source-derived; the component query list is not a measured full-driver query trace.

For each case perform at most 20 paired adaptive comparisons, stopping at the first accepted step. Compare after every comparison. If no successful step occurs within the bound, preserve outcomes and return HOLD; do not extend or relax.

every ledger scalar and event counter
background time/b/rates and actual tentative cumulative-time subtraction
required_driver_parity.cold_warm_and_failure: Include a fixed warm-cache replay of a successful paired step and a bounded forced rejection or max_attempts=1 partial-comparison case. Require identical state and counter side effects, including failed trial accounting.

Compare physical fields exactly while handling explicit source/binary metadata as distinct candidate identity.
